query:
UPDATE ciphertext_digest
            SET
                txn_is_sent = true,
                txn_hash = $1,
                txn_block_number = $2
            WHERE handle = $3
              AND ciphertext IS NOT NULL
              AND ciphertext128 IS NOT NULL
              AND s3_publication_verified_at IS NOT NULL
              AND s3_publication_verified_digest IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ciphertext
